messages:
Noah Kim: Quick check-in 1: partners asked for a condensed slotting + embargo plan for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Who owns what?
Ava Torres: I'll take slotting matrix + calendar. Need SKU counts by region and any firmware holds.
Sam B.: Noted. We have one H200 microcode hold affecting ~4% SKUs; vendor said patch next Tue. If that slips, our fallback path should be H100 -> B200.
Vendor - Nvidia: Confirm microcode patch ETA 2026-04-19 morning. We'll push immutable image tags and a minimal smoke script once validated.
Vendor - AMD: MI300 initial bins are power-limited for sustained long-token runs; recommending mi300-quant for launch. Will post perf delta table (2k/16k/48k).
Ava Torres: For embargo, partners prefer 10-day marketing window plus a 48h infrastructure canary. Legal asked for a signed marketing agreement 5 business days prior.
Noah Kim: Canary rules proposal: 24h staging smoke, then 48h limited prod at 5% traffic. Triggers: 5xx > 0.2%, p99 > baseline *1.2, token-cost delta >20%. Auto-fallback on trigger.
Sam B.: Add requirement: immutable image hash and SBOM uploaded to marketplace before canary starts. Also require a 48h image verification window from vendor.
Vendor - Nvidia: Will provide image tags, SBOM, and a short smoke curl by 2026-04-13.
Vendor - AMD: Perf matrices and quant image tags by 2026-04-13 EOD.
integrator-bot: SI checklist draft created by @Sam B. Link: https://internal.redwood/si-checklist. Items: kernel driver, device-plugin helm values, smoke script, perf harness.
Ava Torres: Action items: (1) Vendors drop tags/SBOMs (2) Sam finalize SI checklist & playbook (3) Ava publish slotting matrix + embargo dates (4) Noah confirm marketing/legal handshake. I'll post the slide by tomorrow noon.
Noah Kim: Thanks. Example curl we can share with SIs: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"mi300-quant","seq_len":2048,"requests":50}'```
